headline: Nvidia stops sending China AI chips approved by the United States
summary: Nvidia has stopped supplying approved advanced AI chips to China, according to its acting CEO. The move casts doubt on a special US-China licensing deal.
why: Nvidia designs the AI and graphics processors used in data centres, and its China sales are shaped by US export controls.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: The company has stopped supplying approved AI chips to China, which removes a sales channel.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The halt puts Nvidia's China sales at risk and raises doubts about the licensing arrangement negotiated between Washington and Beijing.
original_headline: Nvidia deja de enviar a China chips de IA aprobados por Estados Unidos
